clips.title: The story
paras: In Ironforge, Klockmort Spannerspan seeks coral for a new suit of armor. The gnome blacksmith works in Tinker Town and sends you to the Wetlands coast for searing coral, hoping to test new smithing methods in a custom design.

Klockmort Spannerspan has fresh ideas after exchanging insights with master dwarven smith Furen Longbeard. The gnome wants to bring Furen's metallurgy together with his own tinkering to make exceptionally resilient armor. Mountain ore alone will not suit the experiment. Klockmort needs searing coral, a naturally hardened material from the sea.

Searing coral grows only underwater off the Wetlands coast, south of Menethil Harbor. You need to retrieve twenty clusters from beneath the waves, where native aquatic predators prowl. Then you carry the harvest back to Ironforge. Klockmort plans to smelt and hammer the coral into experimental armor plating.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I want to try Furen Longbeard's new techniques on my own piece of armor. And because you helped Furen and he helped me, you're welcome to the armor after I make it!
To finish the piece, I need a special coral, searing coral. It grows in only one place—along the coast south of Menethil Harbor in the Wetlands.
Bring me enough searing coral and I'll get right to work on the armor. And hurry, friend. I'm so eager to get started it's making my toes twist!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Hello hello, friend! Do you have the searing coral? I can't wait to get to work!

clips.title: Completion
paras: That's the stuff! Well done! Now let me get this smelted and hammered so I can apply Furen's technique with my own and then we can see what happens!
Oh my, oh my! I just know the armor will be very very very tough!
